reply.emotion: warm and affectionate, calling a beloved pet over
notes: Used as a friendly noun for a canine pet, but can also be used colloquially to describe a harsh person or a difficult situation.

senses.definition: Mamífero doméstico de la familia de los cánidos, que se caracteriza por su buen olfato y fidelidad hacia el ser humano.
